band_rule: Receptors (of 283) in which the generic position is a CFR; positions = how many of the 368 recurrent positions fall in the band.
reference_source: Zhou et al. 2019 common activation pathway, plus D2.50, DRY, PIF, CWxP, NPxxY, the sodium pocket and 6.30

recovery.rule: The 262 structure positions (GPCRdb structure-based numbers) numbered in at least 142 of the 283 receptors, in CFR score order. A structure position takes the highest CFR score among its generic numbers (gn = that one); expected = rank x known / universe.

scaffold.n_rule: n: receptors with a CFR at the generic position (null: no generic number), from the 368 recurrent positions and the positions that are a CFR in 1 or 2 receptors.
scaffold.source: ADRB2 snake plot layout from GPCRdb

meta.label: GPCompaRe database statistics

sources.numbering: Residue segments and generic numbers: GPCRdb residue maps (GPCRdb API fetched 2026-08-12; GPR4 on its own GPCRdb entry, fetched 2026-10-18).
sources.cfr_set: The 50 top-ranked positions by CFR score.
sources.metadata: Ligand type and family from the list of 287 human Class A receptors, as on the browse page.

meta.threshold_rule: Per receptor, contact pairs with |ΔRRCS| at or above mean + SD of |ΔRRCS| (at least 0.2), the threshold each report uses.
meta.sign: ΔRRCS = active minus inactive. Positive (red): stronger in the active model. Negative (blue): stronger in the inactive model.
